items.title: Nong Khai
items.subtitle: City in Thailand
items.description:
Nong Khai is a city in northeast Thailand. It is the capital of Nong Khai province. Nong Khai city is located in Mueang Nong Khai district.
Nong Khai lies on the Mekong River, near the site of the First Thai–Lao Friendship Bridge, spanning the river to Laos.

items.text:
Nong Khai is a city in northeast Thailand. It is the capital of Nong Khai province. Nong Khai city is located in Mueang Nong Khai district.
Nong Khai lies on the Mekong River, near the site of the First Thai–Lao Friendship Bridge, spanning the river to Laos. Wikipedia

items.markdown:
![Explore Nong Khai: 12 Best Things to Do & More](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07270419-1672-0139-0000-421f56e11a25:10)
Nong Khai is `a charming border town in Isaan (northeastern Thailand) on the banks of the Mekong River, just 20 km from Vientiane, Laos` . Famous for its Thai-Lao culture and the mystical "Naga fireballs," it serves as a major, relaxed gateway for travelers crossing the Thai-Lao Friendship Bridge.[](https://www.tourismthailand.org/Destinations/Provinces/Nong-Khai/582) [[1]](https://www.tourismthailand.org/Destinations/Provinces/Nong-Khai/582)[[2]](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Nong_Khai)

Key Highlights

- **Tha Sadet Market:** A massive, bustling Indochina market running along the riverfront, packed with local crafts, textiles, and imported goods from Laos and Vietnam.[](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Nong_Khai) [[1]](https://tourismthailand.my/ebook/Provincial%20eBook%20Nongkhai_%28en%29_Hyperlink_OK.pdf)[[2]](https://www.onthegotours.com/Thailand/North-Isaan-Mekong-Exploration-4-days)[[3]](https://medium.com/@bosearitra44/the-complete-guide-to-nong-khai-more-than-just-a-border-stop-6693e16d70f5)[[4]](https://sunny-trails.sonnige-pfade.de/nong-khai-thailand/)
- **Sala Keaw Khu:** An unmissable, surreal sculpture park featuring massive, towering religious and mythological figures.[](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Nong_Khai) 
- **Wat Pho Chai:** The heart of local spiritual life, home to the highly revered Luang Por Phra Sai Buddha image.[](https://www.tourismthailand.org/Destinations/Provinces/Nong-Khai/582) 
- **Mekong Riverfront:** A scenic promenade filled with budget-friendly massages, street food (including fresh Mekong catfish), and riverside dining.

Getting There

- **By Train:** The sleeper train from Bangkok’s Krung Thep Aphiwat Terminal to Nong Khai takes about 9–10 hours.
- **Cross-Border to Laos:** From the Nong Khai Railway Station, you can easily take a shuttle train across the border to Thanaleng station (near Vientiane) in just 15 minutes.[](https://www.adventuresofjellie.com/thailand/nong-khai-guide) [[1]](https://www.adventuresofjellie.com/thailand/nong-khai-guide)[[2]](https://www.baolau.com/blog/bangkok-to-nong-khai-by-train/)[[3]](https://www.thailandtrains.com/guide-to-train-travel-from-ayutthaya-to-nong-khai/)[[4]](https://www.thaitrainguide.com/international/laos/)
